### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>mattn/go-shellwords (github.com/mattn/go-shellwords)</summary>

### [`v1.0.17`](https://redirect.github.com/mattn/go-shellwords/releases/tag/v1.0.17)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/mattn/go-shellwords/compare/v1.0.16...v1.0.17)

#### What's Changed

- Preserve empty quoted arguments before command substitutions by [@​bensynapse](https://redirect.github.com/bensynapse) in [#​83](https://redirect.github.com/mattn/go-shellwords/pull/83)
- Recognize file descriptor prefixes for input redirections by [@​n0liu](https://redirect.github.com/n0liu) in [#​82](https://redirect.github.com/mattn/go-shellwords/pull/82)
- Don't treat quoted or expanded words as env assignments by [@​bardrop](https://redirect.github.com/bardrop) in [#​85](https://redirect.github.com/mattn/go-shellwords/pull/85)
- Keep assignment values whole and never treat split expansion fields as envs by [@​mattn](https://redirect.github.com/mattn) in [#​86](https://redirect.github.com/mattn/go-shellwords/pull/86)

#### New Contributors

- [@​bensynapse](https://redirect.github.com/bensynapse) made their first contribution in [#​83](https://redirect.github.com/mattn/go-shellwords/pull/83)
